4.column:
Devin, Nate V and Thom are tied at 11–3 with two games left. A game back: Andy R, Dan, Josh, Peggy and Mike Sombloski, who fell three spots when the Raiders and Broncos both lost on him. Melissa dropped six on the same two games and is one of eleven now out, Garret among them. Ariel said Derek wouldn't get any right. Derek is 9–5. Ariel is 5–9.

Thirteen people can still take the week, and it comes down to Lions–Panthers tonight and Falcons–Saints on Monday. Nobody's sides show until kickoff.
